BNB.summary: No price-moving BNB news found for the past week and no scheduled unlocks; the long at the weekly swing-high retest trades on market structure alone.

TRX.summary: Tron Inc. (Nasdaq: TRON), which holds a large TRX treasury, became a Super Representative. Not a big catalyst. TRX has no vesting unlocks.

news.title: Tron Inc. elected a TRON Super Representative, moving into block production and governance revenue

SYRUP.summary: Fundamentals look steady: Maple's loan book is growing, syrupUSDC has expanded to Solana and buybacks continue. SYRUP is fully unlocked, so there is no supply overhang for the long.

news.title: Maple active loans reach about $1.7B in Q3, up 12% while DeFi lending fell
Maple's syrupUSDC yield stablecoin expands to Solana

SUI.summary: Bullish ecosystem news (Hashi BTC lending nearing mainnet, ongoing buybacks) works against the short. A Community Reserve unlock on Nov 1 has an undisclosed amount, and the team/VC vesting has ended.

news.title: Hashi Bitcoin lending on Sui nears phased mainnet with $500M+ in partner commitments, including Anchorage
Sui buybacks total about 916K SUI year to date, funded by stablecoin yield and fees

unlock.note: Community Reserve per Tokenomist (amount paywalled). DropsTab shows small monthly tranches (Community Reserve, Mysten treasury, early contributors). Investor/team vesting has ended.

APT.summary: Investor and contributor vesting ended Oct 12, cutting monthly unlocks by about 60%, which takes some sell pressure off and works against the short. The next unlock is a Community tranche on Nov 11 with an undisclosed amount.

news.title: Aptos ships an opt-in encrypted mempool on mainnet to curb front-running
Block-STM v2 parallel execution enabled by default on Aptos mainnet
Staking emissions still outpace burns, so APT net supply grows about 1.4M a month

unlock.note: Community allocation per Tokenomist (amount paywalled). The four-year investor/core-contributor schedule ended Oct 12.

LTC.summary: Only small Canary spot ETF flows this week. LTC is proof-of-work with no unlocks, so there is nothing that changes the short thesis.

news.title: Canary Litecoin ETF (LTCC) takes about $581K in inflows after a week of flat flows

JUP.summary: The 1000x 'YOLO' perps launch did about $1B in volume on its first day, but JUP fell with the market. No dated unlock before Dec 5; the next Jupuary cliff is reported for Jan 2027.

news.title: Jupiter launches 'YOLO', an unaudited 500x-1000x leverage product on SOL/BTC/ETH
Jupiter's 1000x perps product does about $1B in volume on day one

FET.summary: FET is still recovering from the Sep 20 SingularityNET bridge exploit, and AGIX-to-FET conversions remain paused. Tokenomist lists an AGIX-migration pool release on Oct 28 with no amount, but another source shows all unlocks complete, so treat it as low confidence.

news.title: Commentary notes FET lagging the rally while AGIX-to-FET conversions stay paused after the bridge exploit

unlock.note: AGIX migration pool per Tokenomist; app.tokenomics.com shows all unlocks complete. This is a migration release, not team/investor vesting, and its supply impact is uncertain while conversions are paused. Low confidence.

RSR.summary: Nothing new this week. The Oct 12 Upbit listing spike is the last big catalyst, and governance's 'High burn' setting pauses treasury unlocks this quarter.

JTO.summary: No JTO-specific news; it fell with the Oct 15 altcoin selloff. There is no cliff unlock, but linear weekly vesting (about 2.6M JTO to investors and contributors) adds steady supply, which suits the short.

news.title: JTO drops about 6% in a broad altcoin selloff tied to an Asian equity rout

ATOM.summary: No verifiable price-moving ATOM news this week. ATOM is inflationary with no vesting cliffs.

WLD.summary: WLD jumped about 14% on World's World ID suite for banks, which supports the long. Supply keeps unlocking continuously at about 2.9M WLD/day, with no single cliff.

news.title: WLD surges about 14% as World launches World ID verification for banks and financial firms

OP.summary: OP has strong momentum against the short: it rallied on Unichain moving to OP Enterprise (mainnet move Oct 29) and on Upgrade 20 buybacks, which start Feb 2027. A small Seed Fund unlock follows on Dec 1.

news.title: OP rallies about 22% on Unichain's move to OP Enterprise; Upgrade 20 directs 50% of Superchain revenue to OP buybacks

unlock.note: Seed Fund cliff (0.1% of max supply), single source DefiLlama.

HBAR.summary: No verified HBAR news this week. Before the window, tokenized stocks went live on HashPack and Hitachi left the Hedera Council. There are no scheduled unlocks.

SEI.summary: The REX-Osprey staked SEI ETF registration is due to go effective around Oct 23, which is a risk for the short. Monthly Ecosystem Reserve unlock on Nov 15; the Oct 15 tranche (about 55.6M SEI) was absorbed without a sell-off.

news.title: Monthly ecosystem unlock of about 55.6M SEI absorbed without a sell-off
CFTC-regulated exchange self-certifies USD-settled SEI perpetual futures

unlock.note: Monthly Ecosystem Reserve release per Tokenomist (amount paywalled; Oct tranche was ~55.6M SEI).
